title: An algorithm for approximating the metric projection onto a superelliptic disk
summary: We study conditions under which the metric projection onto a strictly convex body can be approximated by the projections onto polygonal approximations (in the Hausdorff-Pompeiu sense) of the strictly convex body itself. We provide a necessary condition by proving that the union of all the vertices of the polygonal approximations must be dense in the boundary of that set.
